mapper.sql: select o.inbound_order_id, o.inbound_order_no, o.inbound_type, o.source_type, o.source_no, o.supplier_id, o.supplier_name, o.customer_id, o.customer_name, o.warehouse_id, o.warehouse_name, o.inbound_date, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.order_status, d.item_summary, o.audit_by, o.audit_time, o.post_by, o.post_time, o.cancel_by, o.cancel_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from erp_inbound_order o left join ( select inbound_order_id, group_concat(concat_ws(' / ', item_code, item_name, color_name, spec_name, batch_no) order by inbound_detail_id separator '; ') as item_summary from erp_inbound_order_detail group by inbound_order_id ) d on d.inbound_order_id = o.inbound_order_id
mapper.insert: insert into erp_inbound_order(inbound_order_no, inbound_type, source_type, source_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, customer_id, customer_name, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, inbound_date, total_qty, total_amount, order_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{inboundOrderNo}, #{inboundType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{warehouseId}, #{warehouseName}, #{inboundDate}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update erp_inbound_order set inbound_type = #{inboundType}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_no = #{sourceNo}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, supplier_name = #{supplierName}, customer_id = #{customerId}, customer_name = #{customerName}, warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, inbound_date = #{inboundDate}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId} and order_status = '草稿'

update erp_inbound_order set order_status = '已入库', audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, post_by = #{postBy}, post_time = #{postTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId} and order_status in ('草稿', '已审核')

update erp_inbound_order set order_status = '已取消', cancel_by = #{cancelBy}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId} and order_status = '已入库'
mapper.delete: delete from erp_inbound_order where order_status = '草稿' and inbound_order_id in #{inboundOrderId}
